text:
chris_release: heads-up — offsite private installer artifacts for v2.8.1-staging uploaded to s3://redwood-offsite/staging/1904123456. ready for signoff for tonight's change window 22:00 UTC. checksum + cosign sig included. need decision: pin images to 2.8.1-rc3-build or roll forward to rc4?

deploy-bot: build completed — artifacts list:
```
installer-offsite-2.8.1-staging.tar.gz  sha256: 3fa1c9d4b6e7c8b2a9f4d1e2c3b5a6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b
airgap-bundle-2.8.1-staging.zip   sha256: d4b2c1a9f8e7d6c5b4a3f2e1d0c9b8a7f6e5d4c3b2a1f0e9d8c7b6a5f4e3d2c1
cosign signature present: cosign://projects/redwood/1904123456
```
verify with: `cosign verify --key /secrets/cosign-offsite-2024.pub <artifact>`

maria_dev: quick Q — rc4 has the L2 perf tweak but hasn't run on private-hw. i'd prefer pinning to rc3 for private installs until we can canary rc4 in dedicated.

kevin_sre: agree with pin to rc3 for private/VPC. Rollforward plan after canary: promote rc4 -> rc4-canary -> rc4-prod. Rollback plan (high level): revert installer manifest to pinned tag + republish installer tarball with pinned manifest, trigger redeploy. need ssh access to offsite staging nodes for step 2. @ops_oncall can you confirm access?

ops_oncall: confirmed — i have jumpbox creds and will standby during 22:00-00:00 UTC window. :white_check_mark: if something hits >90% cpu on replicas i'll escalate.

saleha_pm: updating release notes now. note for customers: private-vpc/offsite ingestion may take 5-10m and require manual restart for legacy airgap clients. we'll include explicit rollback messaging and contact list.

maria_dev: also — cosign key rotation is scheduled for tomorrow morning. we should not sign tonight with the rotating key. use backup key `cosign-offsite-2024` that lives in KMS path projects/redwood/keys/cosign-offsite-2024. I've updated CI to reference that.

chris_release: copied. manifest diff for installer (important bit):
```
- image: quay.redwood/proxy:2.8.1-rc4
+ image: quay.redwood/proxy:2.8.1-rc3-pinned
  imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  installerVersion: 2.8.1-staging
```
I've committed the pinned manifest to release branch and attached signed artifact.

deploy-bot: artifact replication to regional edge caches started. replication ETA ~18m. replication tasks: 14/16 completed. logs: https://int-logs.redwood/replication/1904123456

kevin_sre: i've reviewed and added a short rollback checklist in the runbook: https://internal/runbooks/offsite-installer-rollback. TL;DR: 1) revert manifest tag 2) recreate installer tar 3) upload + cosign 4) trigger redeploy script `scripts/redeploy-offsite.sh --manifest pinned` 5) notify customers. i'll be primary oncall for rollback.

saleha_pm: timeline: staging replication finishes by 21:58 UTC, signoff at 22:00, push to customers starts 22:10. i'll draft the customer email now and queue it for send at 22:05.

chris_release: signoff check — @maria_dev @kevin_sre please reply with ack to proceed with pinned rc3 today.

maria_dev: :thumbsup: ack, pin to rc3. go ahead.

ops_oncall: i'll monitor and post healthcheck pings to this thread.

deploy-bot: deploy window started (1904123600). installer deployed to staging nodes. health checks: proxy (ok), api (ok), kv-store (degraded -> recovered). final replication 16/16.

kevin_sre: validated post-deploy smoke tests. everything green from my side. leaving notes in runbook about observed transient KV spike.

saleha_pm: release notes published: "2.8.1-staging (private installer) — images pinned to 2.8.1-rc3 for private/VPC installs. Start time 22:10 UTC."

chris_release: thanks everyone — closing signoff. if rollback required ping me and @kevin_sre.

deploy-bot: thread closed for deploy window 1904123670.
